headword: {一昨昨年|いっさくさくねん}
gloss: three years ago; the year before the year before last

definitions.gloss: three years ago; the year before the year before last
definitions.explanation: More formal equivalent of {三年前|さんねんまえ}. Used in written and formal spoken contexts.

examples.japanese: {一昨昨年|いっさくさくねん}の{夏|なつ}だった。
examples.english: It was the summer three years ago.

examples.japanese: {一昨昨年|いっさくさくねん}から{計画|けいかく}していた{旅行|りょこう}だ。
examples.english: It's a trip we'd been planning since three years ago.

examples.japanese: {一昨昨年|いっさくさくねん}の{売上|うりあげ}と{比較|ひかく}すると、{大幅|おおはば}に{増加|ぞうか}している。
examples.english: Compared to sales from three years ago, there has been a significant increase.

notes:
A formal time expression for "three years ago." Follows the pattern of {一昨年|おととし} (two years ago) by adding another {昨|さく} prefix. In everyday conversation, {三年前|さんねんまえ} is far more common.

RELATED TIME WORDS:
- {去年|きょねん}: last year
- {一昨年|おととし}/{一昨年|いっさくねん}: two years ago
- {一昨昨日|さきおととい}: three days ago

USAGE:
Primarily appears in formal writing such as reports, articles, and official documents. In speech, speakers almost always use {三年前|さんねんまえ} instead.
